Container.Name: caddy-reverse-proxy
Container.Overview: Caddy reverse proxy with automatic HTTPS via Cloudflare DNS-01 challenge, plus a web UI for managing routes and viewing certificate status without restarting the container.
Container.Description: Caddy reverse proxy built with the Cloudflare DNS plugin for automatic SSL certificate provisioning via DNS-01 challenges. Ideal for servers behind Tailscale or NAT where HTTP-01 challenges cannot reach the server. The bundled web UI on port 9999 lets you add, edit, and toggle routes (live-reloaded — no container restart) and shows certificate status, expiry, and Caddy logs. The Caddyfile remains editable by hand if you prefer.
